source.name: 腾讯新闻·九五体育 (Tencent News): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商
source.note: Translation: 'Tianjin Jinmen Tiger FC's chest advertisement is "Guohaibo", which is "Tianjin · National Maritime Museum".' A survey of all 16 CSL clubs' 2026 chest sponsors. Football Daily (9 March 2026) and Orange Cat Football's chest-ads collection (25 March 2026) name 国海博 for Tianjin too.
source.quote: 天津津门虎足球俱乐部的胸前广告是“国海博”，就是“天津・国家海洋博物馆”

source.name: 足球报 via 腾讯新闻 (Football Daily via Tencent News): 中超新气象：11队更换胸前广告，首轮上座再超去年
source.note: Translation: 'Tianjin Jinmen Tiger, while keeping TEDA Nangang Group, introduced Guohaibo as a co-sponsor.' The paragraph is about clubs' 2026 chest (胸前) advertisements. Orange Cat Football's 2026 chest-ads collection (news.qq.com/rain/a/20260325A03SEJ00, 25 March 2026) likewise lists 天津津门虎（泰达南港） among the chest sponsors, as a club-related (关联方) advertiser. The exact chest arrangement of the two wordmarks could not be verified from sources we could open.
source.quote: 天津津门虎则在保留泰达南港集团的同时，引入国海博作为联合赞助商

source.name: Footy Headlines: 2026 Chinese Super League Kits - All Releases So Far
source.note: Kit supplier for all 16 CSL clubs in 2026; the article carries its own section for Tianjin Jinmen Tiger (bespoke home design). Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The club's launch announcement of the same day (via zhibo8, 28 January 2026, 10:24) confirms the purple home shirt.
source.quote: Nike has officially unveiled the 2026 Home Kits for all 16 teams competing in the Chinese Super League (CSL).

summary: 2026 CSL home kit by Nike (launched 28 January 2026; purple with a dark tiger-stripe graphic). Chest sponsors for 2026: 国海博 — the 'Guohaibo' wordmark of Tianjin's National Maritime Museum of China, new for 2026 — and 泰达南港集团 (TEDA Nangang Group), retained from 2025; both are documented as chest (胸前) sponsors by Chinese press, but the exact chest arrangement could not be verified. Not complete: the back, sleeve and shorts placements for 2026 could not be verified from sources we could open, and footballkitarchive.com blocks scripts.
